Startsida.title: Kämpabo – Family Farm and Holiday Accommodation in Småland
Startsida.meta: Stay at a family farm in Småland outside Anderstorp. Discover Kämpabo, Lillstugan and Axel's lake with fishing and a rowing boat.
Startsida.h1: Kämpabo – Stay at a Småland Family Farm
Startsida.p1: Welcome to Kämpabo, a family farm in the Småland countryside outside Anderstorp. Here is space for both excursions and relaxing days without a full schedule.
Startsida.p2: A rowing trip or a moment with the fishing rod can be the excursion of the day. As a guest at Kämpabo, you can borrow the rowing boat and have the opportunity to fish in the lake our family calls Axel's lake.
Startsida.h2_1: Accommodation for Small and Large Groups
Startsida.p3: In Lillstugan, you can choose separate accommodation for a smaller group or rent the entire house when traveling together.
Startsida.p4: The farm has been in the family for several generations. Read about its history and life in the entrepreneurial Småland district.
Startsida.h2_2: What do you want to discover in Småland?
Startsida.p5: From ski slopes and western adventures to moorlands and industrial history – on the excursion pages you will find destinations for different interests and seasons.

OmKampabo.title: About Kämpabo – The Family Farm and its History
OmKampabo.meta: Get to know Kämpabo outside Anderstorp: the family farm, Axel Ljungberg's Småland Leather, and the area's history of crafts and enterprise.
OmKampabo.p1: Kämpabo is a family farm in the countryside outside Anderstorp. The farm has been in the family for several generations and is located in a part of Småland where agriculture, small industry, and entrepreneurship have long lived side by side.
OmKampabo.p2: On the farm, Axel Ljungberg ran the leather industry Småländska Läder with around 40 employees. The industry made the farm a workplace for many people and connects Kämpabo to the area's long tradition of manufacturing and small business.
OmKampabo.h2_1: The District behind the Gnosjö Spirit
OmKampabo.p3: The Gnosjö Spirit is associated with enterprise and cooperation. To understand it, it is worth looking back at the work carried out by the area's waterways. During the 18th and 19th centuries, water power was used in small workshops for, among other things, forging and wire drawing.
OmKampabo.p4: The iron was processed into narrow blanks and then drawn into wire. The wire became the material for many everyday objects, and metalworking was often a complement to agriculture. During the end of the 19th century, small industry took up more and more space. This development can still be discovered at the Töllstorp Industrial Museum.
OmKampabo.p5: Today we welcome guests to Lillstugan. The accommodations are described on their own pages, where you can choose the option that suits you.

VaraBoenden.title: Our Accommodations – Lillstugan at Kämpabo
VaraBoenden.meta: Lillstugan at Kämpabo has two separate accommodations in the same house. Choose upstairs for 4, downstairs for 8, or rent the entire house with 12 regular beds.
VaraBoenden.p1: Lillstugan contains two separate accommodations that can be rented individually or together. Compare the options here.
VaraBoenden.p2: The smaller accommodation is on the upper floor and has 4 regular beds. An option for a smaller family, a couple, or friends who want to stay on the farm.
VaraBoenden.p3: The accommodation on the lower floor has 8 regular beds. There is room for a larger group who wants to share the same accommodation during their stay.
VaraBoenden.p4: The entire house has 12 regular beds distributed between the two accommodations.

VaraBoenden.p5: Unsure which accommodation to choose? Describe your group in the request.

LillstuganUppe.meta: Rent Lillstugan upstairs at Kämpabo outside Anderstorp. A separate accommodation on the upper floor for a smaller group, with 4 regular beds.
LillstuganUppe.p1: Lillstugan upstairs is located on the upper floor and has 4 regular beds. The accommodation can be rented separately and suits a smaller family, a couple, or a few friends.
LillstuganUppe.p2: If needed, an additional person can sleep on a regular sofa. It is not a sofa bed and is not counted as a regular bed. State in the request if you need to use it.
LillstuganUppe.p3: If you need more beds, you can book the entire Lillstugan.

HelaLillstugan.p2: You distribute the group between the separate residences upstairs and downstairs.
HelaLillstugan.btn3: See what to do in the area
HelaLillstugan.p3: If needed, an additional person can sleep on a regular sofa upstairs and up to two people on regular sofas downstairs. They are not sofa beds. State in your request if you need to use a sofa.

AttGora.p3: For those who want an active day in Hestra. Choose among activities on the mountain and read our guide for planning by season.

BoendeNaraIsaberg.title: Accommodation near Isaberg – Kämpabo in Småland
BoendeNaraIsaberg.meta: Visit Isaberg and stay at Kämpabo outside Anderstorp. Read about cycling, skiing, and family activities and choose an accommodation in Lillstugan.
BoendeNaraIsaberg.p1: At Kämpabo outside Anderstorp, you can stay during the trip to Isaberg in Hestra. Choose your accommodation in Lillstugan and plan the activities on the mountain here.
BoendeNaraIsaberg.btn1: Choose accommodation for the Isaberg visit
BoendeNaraIsaberg.p2: Luge, high ropes course, and adventure golf provide more ways to spend time at Isaberg. Look at the respective activity's opening hours and conditions when planning a family day. The offering does not have to be the same every day or during all parts of the year.
BoendeNaraIsaberg.p3: Isaberg has mountain bike trails in different degrees of difficulty, a technical area with a pumptrack, and the possibility of lift-served cycling. You can choose between tours in the terrain and downhill trails on the mountain. Read the trail information before deciding on the setup, especially if the group has different experience with mountain biking.
BoendeNaraIsaberg.p4: Bicycles can be rented at Isaberg. Check that the right size and equipment are available for your dates. Also read which bike pass is needed for the trails and lifts you want to use.
BoendeNaraIsaberg.btn2: See trails, bike rental, and passes at Isaberg
BoendeNaraIsaberg.p5: During the ski season, Isaberg offers alpine skiing, ski rental, and ski school. Check open slopes, lifts, and booking options before the trip; winter conditions affect the offering.

BoendeNaraHighChaparral.title: Accommodation near High Chaparral – Kämpabo in Småland
BoendeNaraHighChaparral.meta: Visit High Chaparral in Kulltorp and stay at the family farm Kämpabo. Plan the park day and choose a separate accommodation or the entire Lillstugan.
BoendeNaraHighChaparral.p1: Stay in the countryside outside Anderstorp when the family is visiting High Chaparral in Kulltorp. Kämpabo offers accommodation in Lillstugan; you book the park's tickets separately.
BoendeNaraHighChaparral.btn1: Choose accommodation for the park visit
BoendeNaraHighChaparral.p2: High Chaparral is located in Kulltorp and is a theme park with the Wild West as its theme. Shows and meetings with the park's characters alternate with things you can participate in yourself. Among the experiences are a train ride and gold panning.
BoendeNaraHighChaparral.p3: Let the family choose a few things that are most important to catch. Then base your day on the show program and the park's map, so you don't discover late in the day that a performance you wanted to see has already taken place.
BoendeNaraHighChaparral.h2_2: Tickets and Opening Hours at High Chaparral
BoendeNaraHighChaparral.p4: First check that the park is open on the date you plan to visit. Then check tickets, show times, and conditions for the activities. Some experiences cost extra in addition to the entrance, so everything shown in the park's offering should not be counted as included in the ticket.
BoendeNaraHighChaparral.btn2: See High Chaparral's opening hours and tickets
BoendeNaraHighChaparral.btn3: Read the park's information before the visit
BoendeNaraHighChaparral.btn4: Read about renting the entire house

BoendeNaraStoreMosse.title: Accommodation near Store Mosse National Park – Kämpabo
BoendeNaraStoreMosse.meta: Stay at Kämpabo when you want to discover Store Mosse. Read about the visitor center, bird watching, and how to choose a hike based on time and company.
BoendeNaraStoreMosse.h1: Accommodation near Store Mosse National Park
BoendeNaraStoreMosse.p1: Stay in Lillstugan at Kämpabo outside Anderstorp during your trip to Store Mosse. Here you get help choosing an excursion in the national park based on time, surface, and company.
BoendeNaraStoreMosse.h2_1: Hiking and Entrances in Store Mosse
BoendeNaraStoreMosse.p2: Store Mosse has several entrances and a landscape of bogs and forest. Trails and footbridges let you discover different parts of the national park. First think about how long you want to be out and what the group can handle, and then choose a trail and starting point that suits.
BoendeNaraStoreMosse.p3: At the main entrance is the visitor center naturum Store Mosse, with exhibitions and information about nature. From there, among others, Wibecksleden starts. For children, there is also the Forest Troll's Path adjacent to naturum. Those who want to walk further can read about the hike around Kävsjön.
BoendeNaraStoreMosse.btn1: Compare trails and experiences in Store Mosse
BoendeNaraStoreMosse.p4: Bird watching does not have to mean a long hike. The large bird tower is located at the main entrance and overlooks Kävsjön. Bring binoculars if you have them and let a moment at the tower become part of the excursion.
BoendeNaraStoreMosse.h2_2: Plan according to Surface and Company
BoendeNaraStoreMosse.p5: For a stroller or wheelchair, the choice of trail is particularly important. Wibecksleden is adapted for, among other things, strollers and wheelchairs, but this does not automatically apply to all trails in the national park. Read the current visitor information and check naturum's opening hours before you go.
BoendeNaraStoreMosse.btn2: Read about entrances, service, and accessibility

BoendeNaraAnderstorp.title: Accommodation near Scandinavian Raceway in Anderstorp – Kämpabo
BoendeNaraAnderstorp.meta: Stay at Kämpabo outside Anderstorp during a visit to Scandinavian Raceway. Read about Formula 1 history and go-karting at Scandinavian Kartway.
BoendeNaraAnderstorp.h1: Accommodation near Scandinavian Raceway in Anderstorp
BoendeNaraAnderstorp.p1: Kämpabo offers accommodation in Lillstugan in the countryside outside Anderstorp for those visiting Scandinavian Raceway.
BoendeNaraAnderstorp.p2: The racing circuit's history begins with Anderstorp Racing Club, which was formed in 1966. The track was completed in 1968 and Sweden's first Formula 1 Grand Prix was held here in 1973. During the 1970s, a total of six Formula 1 World Championship races were arranged in Anderstorp.
BoendeNaraAnderstorp.p3: Check the organizer's information for the competition or activity you want to visit. The event calendar, entrance, tickets, and times dictate how the day can be structured. A motor racing circuit does not function like a museum with the same visitor options every day.
BoendeNaraAnderstorp.btn2: See events and visitor info at Scandinavian Raceway
BoendeNaraAnderstorp.p4: Opposite the motor circuit's main entrance is Scandinavian Kartway. The go-kart track's layout is a scaled-down version of the large racing circuit. Here there is drop-in during specified opening hours and the possibility to book group driving.
BoendeNaraAnderstorp.p5: Check current conditions and opening hours before you go, especially if children are going to drive or if you want to stay together as a group. Go-karting is a separate activity with its own booking.
BoendeNaraAnderstorp.btn4: Ask about accommodation for your visit

BoendeNaraGnosjo.title: Accommodation near Gnosjö – Töllstorp and the Gnosjö Spirit
BoendeNaraGnosjo.meta: Discover Töllstorp Industrial Museum and the history behind the Gnosjö Spirit. Stay at the family farm Kämpabo outside Anderstorp during your visit.
BoendeNaraGnosjo.h1: Accommodation near Gnosjö and Töllstorp Industrial Museum
BoendeNaraGnosjo.p1: Gnosjö is known for its companies, but a visit can also be about the technology and craftsmanship that came before today's industry. Stay at Kämpabo outside Anderstorp and let an excursion to Töllstorp Industrial Museum provide a closer picture of the district.
BoendeNaraGnosjo.p2: In Töllstorp you get to see how iron and metal wire could become products for everyday life. Trip hammers, wire drawing, wire mesh weaving, and older manufacturing machines show different stages of the work. Among the objects manufactured are hairpins and pot ears.
BoendeNaraGnosjo.p3: The museum environment gathers buildings and workshops that tell the story of the emergence of small industry. Here it becomes easier to understand how small-scale production developed and why water power was of such great importance.
BoendeNaraGnosjo.p4: Gnosjö Local History Society keeps the museum open during the summer months and arranges tours. Check current opening hours and when a guided tour can be conducted before planning the day. If you want to visit the museum as a group, you should find out about booking options in advance.
BoendeNaraGnosjo.btn1: Find current museum info at Visit Gnosjö
BoendeNaraGnosjo.h2_3: Also see a later industrial environment
BoendeNaraGnosjo.p5: Hyltén's Industrial Museum shows a preserved metal factory with machines, tools, and offices. A visit there can provide a different picture of the district's manufacturing than the workshops in Töllstorp. Check the opening hours for each museum; they have different visitor setups.
BoendeNaraGnosjo.btn2: Read about the industrial museums at Gnosjö Municipality
